page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E3.Flex.1-8 is a flexible compute instance within the standard general-purpose tier. Powered by an AMD EPYC 7742 processor clocked at a base frequency of 2.25 GHz, the instance provides 2 vCPUs supported by 1 dedicated physical core with 2 threads. The system features an x86_64 execution environment alongside 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance does not include integrated hardware accelerators, featuring zero GPUs, nor does it supply local NVMe or SSD storage. Persistent storage requirements must be addressed via external network-attached volumes. In terms of connectivity, the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. The resource layout reflects a standardized 1:4 compute-to-memory profile, ensuring dedicated CPU scheduling without the multi-tenant contention risks seen in shared or burstable environments.

Given the balanced allocation of 2 vCPUs and 8.0 GB of RAM, VM.Standard.E3.Flex.1-8 is suited for moderate baseline workloads. Appropriate use cases encompass lightweight web servers, microservices, continuous integration runners, developmental staging environments, and entry-level background worker services that do not require high-throughput local disk storage or specialized GPU acceleration.
